description_en: Associate the user's virtual private cloud (VPC) and vSwitch with a 5G high-speed cloud instance.
description_zh: 关联用户Vpc和Vswitch到5G高速上云实例
kebab_example: aliyun cc5g attach-vpc-to-net-link --wireless-cloud-connector-id cc5g-xxxx --net-link-id cciot-xxxx --vpc-id vpc-bp1etmgc4vooo5ahbkzou --vswitches vsw-xxxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachVpcToNetLink

parameters.help_en: The ID of the 5G high-speed cloud instance.
parameters.name: wireless_cloud_connector_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC).
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The vSwitches under the customer's virtual private cloud (VPC). You must specify two vSwitches for active-standby redundancy, and their zones must match the zone of the network connectivity.
parameters.help_zh: 客户的专有网络下的交换机，必须是2个进行主备，且交换机的可用区和和网络连接的可用区保持一致
parameters.name: vswitches

parameters.help_en:
Ensures idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value from your client for this parameter across different requests. Only ASCII characters are supported, and the value cannot exceed 64 characters.  
If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken identity. The RequestId may differ for each API request.
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run of the request. Valid values:  
true: Sends a dry run request without associating the user's VPC and vSwitch. The system checks whether required parameters are provided, whether the request format is valid, and whether business limits are met. If the check fails, an error is returned. If the check passes, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.  
false (default): Sends a normal request. After passing the checks, the user's VPC and vSwitch are associated with the 5G high-speed cloud instance.
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会关联用户Vpc和Vswitch。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后关联用户Vpc和Vswitch到5G高速上云实例
parameters.name: dry_run
